title: Technology Sector Update for 06/28/2018: PRGS,MRVL,CAVM,IZEA
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +1.5%
AAPL +1.0%
IBM +2.1%
CSCO +1.8%
GOOG +1.4%
Technology stocks firmed Thursday, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 ( XLK ) adding 1.4% in value today while the Philadelphia semiconductor index (^SOX) was posting a 1.0% gain.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
Accenture ( ACN ) climbed to a a high of $165.56 a share on Thursday after the technology consulting and outsourcing firm raised its FY18 outlook after reporting above-consensus Q3 financial results with revenue growth across all segments and led by communications, media and technology. Excluding one-time items, the company earned $1.79 per share during the three months ended May 31, topping the Capital IQ consensus by $0.07 per share. Revenue rose 16% year-over-year to $10.3 billion, also surpassing the $10 billion Street view. Looking ahead, the company is projecting FY18 revenue rising to a range of $9.8 billion to $10.05 billion, spanning the $10.01 billion consensus. Non-GAAP earnings are seen coming in between $6.66 to $6.71 per share, up from it prior view looking for $6.61 to $6.70 per share, compared with the $6.69 per share analyst mean.
In other sector news:
+ Progress Software ( PRGS ) rose more than 16% during Thursday trade after reporting adjusted fiscal Q2 net income and revenue topping Wall Street expectations and also issued an above-consensus FY18 earnings outlook. Excluding one-time items, the application software and data management company earned $0.60 per share during the three months ended May 31, improving on a $0.42 per share non-GAAP profit during the same quarter last year and exceeding the Capital IQ consensus by $0.07 per share. Revenue grew 3.1% year-over-year to $96.1 million compared with $93.2 million in the year-ago period, also beating the $95 million analyst mean. For the 12 months ending Nov. 30, the company is projecting adjusted net income in a range of $2.45 to $2.50 per share, surpassing the Street view by at least $0.03 per share. It also sees revenue this year between $399 million to $404 million, straddling the $403.9 million consensus.
+ Marvell Technology Group ( MRVL ) climbed as much as 10% on Thursday after integrated circuits manufacturer said Chinese regulators have approved its proposed $6.27 billion merger with rival Cavium ( CAVM ). The deal - which calls on Marvell to pay $40 in cash and issue 2.1757 of its shares for each Cavium share, valuing the target company at $90.65 per share - is expected to close in July, subject to the remaining customary closing conditions.
- IZEA (IZEA) retreated to a record low on Thursday, dropping over 17% to a worst-ever share price of 88 cents apiece, after pricing a public offering of 3.6 million shares of its common stock at $1 each, or a 5.7% discount to Wednesday's closing price. The online marketplace connecting marketers and content creators expects to use the net proceeds to fund potential acquisitions of competitive and complementary companies or technologies and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
